create_timestep_with_observation: create a TimeStep NamedTuple with an observation, reward, and terminated flag for RL environments
create_timestep_with_truncation: create a TimeStep with truncated set to True to signal episode length limits
create_action_with_info: create an Action NamedTuple wrapping an agent decision and optional metadata info
use_tensor_type_alias: use the Tensor type alias to accept both numpy arrays and torch tensors as input
use_nestedtensor_type_alias: use the NestedTensor type alias to represent arbitrarily nested tensor structures in RL data
